snippet.title: Voice Over — Reveal Trailer | Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
snippet.description:
Meet some of the voices bringing the companions of Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy to life. 

Aaron Sinn — Haymar Devos, Catachan Jungle Fighter
Jonathan Cox — COGG, Conscript 0-118-B
Britaney Chanel — Epione Spes, Chirurgeon
Stephen Spencer — Saro, Sanctioned Psyker
Rhiannon Moushall — Ra'akhti, Kroot Huntress
Chris Sharpes — Laarthyr Cairnareth, Aeldari Corsair
Ian Russell — Servo-Ossuarium

This is only the first part of the cast reveal, more allies and notable names with their voice actors will be unveiled in the future.

Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy is an upcoming narrative-driven cRPG from Owlcat Games, set in the grim darkness of the 41st Millennium.
